text.p: Torbitt & Castleman, which makes America's Choice salsa, on Friday said it issued a product recall for its 26-ounce America's Choice hot salsa product in the New York City and New England regions.
Any customer who has purchased the product should return it to the store from which it was purchased for full credit, the company said.
The company is voluntarily recalling the product because some salsa packed in cases under the code B7B19 was "under-processed," possibly leading to bacterial growth, a spokesman said.
Torbitt & Castleman has not received any complaints regarding the salsa, the spokesman said.
